_note: Mock agents for the demo user. Each intent runs ONE engine function with the request's inputs and fills {paths} from the engine result. Text is written for Joe Bloggs (e.g. March is his lowest cash month).

intents.text: Based on this year (actual + forecast), after {result.drawings} of drawings and {result.tax} of tax you can repay {result.repayment_capacity} a year, and your current loans take {result.debt_service}. A lender wanting {result.min_cover|times} cover could lend you up to {result.new_loan.max_principal} more over {result.new_loan.term_months|months}, at about {result.new_loan.monthly_payment_at_max} a month.
follow_ups: How much do I owe on my loans?

intents.text: Yes. You're projected to have {result.months[10].closing_cash} at the end of November and {result.closing_cash} on 31 December, after loan repayments. Your lowest point this year was March ({result.months[2].closing_cash}), so plan for next spring.
follow_ups: How much do I owe on my loans?

intents.text: From January to September you made an Operating Surplus of {result.ytd.profit.net} on income of {result.ytd.revenue.total}, a {result.ytd.profit.margin_pct|pct} margin. Operating costs were {result.ytd.costs.total}. Loan repayments ({result.ytd.finance.loan_repayments}) are kept outside that surplus.
follow_ups: Will I have cash for the December feed bill?
